description: Prod-side Anthropic pool-mode policy for explicitly configured relay accounts. The backend applies this policy through its account reconciliation path; it keeps retry behavior local to the configured account and does not provision additional hosts.

notes.no_min_account_gate: Pool mode is unconditionally on for matching stubs; same-account retry avoids cooldown-on-first-503 without requiring a separate account pool.
notes.out_of_scope_fields: This pipeline writes ONLY credentials.pool_mode + credentials.pool_mode_retry_count. Other stub fields (base_url, concurrency, priority, group bindings) remain admin-UI / out-of-band per skill §2.
notes.retry_count_choice: 3 = three in-place retries per failure (four attempts total on the same account). Larger values amplify cross-region RTT and pile retries onto the stub's local concurrency cap. If empirically needed, bump here and re-apply — never edit per-stub credentials by hand.
